state_source: DefenceController.get_fire_visual_snapshot(): read-only captured state; no mechanical changes.

mapping.raise_and_hold: Frames0..3 over the captured early parry duration; hold frame3 while guarding. A quick-release parry continues showing guard until its captured endpoint.
mapping.missed_tap: Frames5..7 over the remaining captured control commitment; defence reuse does not prolong the pose or control lock.
mapping.confirmed_parry: Only an actual Fire PARRIED HealthResult starts frames4..7 over one captured early-window duration. Controls remain immediately available.
mapping.confirmed_block: Only an actual Fire BLOCKED HealthResult shows frame4, then frame3, over one captured early-window duration; held guarding continues.
mapping.held_release: Frames5..7 over one captured early-window duration, with no added control lock.
mapping.interruption: Attacks, hit reactions, school changes, stage lock, death and retry clear presentation. Hurt/attack has priority.

limits: Source review GIF dwell is not used as gameplay timing.
Engine import, feel, both facings, contacts, release/cancellation and retry need user validation.
